mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (as measured by FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern is not observed in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a further increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.2 percentage points in one month signals aggressive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) fails to predict negative 5-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern is not observed in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) by more than 0.5 percentage points signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate declines > 0.5pp in 1 quarter
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth rate declines > 0.5pp in 1 quarter.
